newsitem.title: INDIA: India advisory board on bank frauds set up - RBI.
newsitem.headline: India advisory board on bank frauds set up - RBI.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Monday an advisory board had been set up to advise it on bank fraud cases.

"Advisory Board on bank frauds has been set up to advise the Reserve Bank of India on the cases referred by the Central Bureau of Investigation either directly or through the Monistry of Finance for investigation/registration of cases against bank officers of the rank of general managaer and above," the RBI statement said.
The members of the Board were:
S.S. Tarapore, RBI ex-deputy governor Chairman
B.V. CHavan, retired Bombay High Court judge
and member of RBI Services Board Member
B.N. Bhagwat, retired secretary, Govt. of India Member
Satish Sawhney, retired director general of
Y.H. Malegam, chartered accountant and senior
partner in M/S S.S. Billimoria & Co. Member
